args.command:
cd /mnt/user-data/workspace && cat > probe_cli_errors.py <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, shutil

CLI = "/mnt/skills/public/podcast-generation/scripts/generate.py"
STRIP = ["VOLCENGINE_TTS_APPID", "VOLCENGINE_TTS_ACCESS_TOKEN",
         "MINIMAX_API_KEY", "PODCAST_GENERATION_PROVIDER"]

tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="podcast-cli-probe-", dir="/mnt/user-data/outputs")
script_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "script.json")
out_mp3 = os.path.join(tmpdir, "fresh-missing.mp3")

with open(script_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump({"lines": [{"speaker": "male", "paragraph": "Hello"}]}, f)

assert not os.path.exists(out_mp3), "output must start missing"

env = os.environ.copy()
stripped_present = [k for k in STRIP if k in env]
for k in STRIP:
    env.pop(k, None)

print("CLI:", CLI, "exists:", os.path.exists(CLI))
print("tmpdir:", tmpdir)
print("credential vars present in parent env (names only):", stripped_present or "none")
print("credential vars still set in child env:", [k for k in STRIP if k in env] or "none")
print("=" * 70)

def run(label, argv):
    print(f"--- {label} ---")
    cp = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True,
                        env=env, timeout=120)
    print("argv:", argv)
    print("returncode:", cp.returncode)
    print("stdout:\n" + (cp.stdout or "<empty>"))
    print("stderr:\n" + (cp.stderr or "<empty>"))
    print("=" * 70)
    return cp

cp1 = run("case A: real invocation", [sys.executable, CLI,
        "--script-file", script_path, "--output-file", out_mp3])
cp2 = run("case B: control, no args", [sys.executable, CLI])

print("--- outcome ---")
exists = os.path.exists(out_mp3)
print("mp3 exists:", exists)
print("mp3 size (bytes):", os.path.getsize(out_mp3) if exists else "n/a")
print("files in tmpdir:", sorted(os.listdir(tmpdir)))
EOF
python probe_cli_errors.py
